index.title: Security Audit Kit — web/API security testing toolkit (DAST + SCA)
index.meta_desc: Security Audit Kit: cross-platform, configuration-driven web/API security testing automation. DAST modules (access control, upload, injection, CORS, and more) and SCA (CVE, SAST, secrets), non-destructive with automatic rollback, consultant-grade reports. Open source, Apache-2.0.

scan.title: Open Scanner (passive) — Security Audit Kit
scan.meta_desc: Free passive security check: security headers, cookie flags, CORS misconfiguration, and vulnerable server versions (CVE) from the banner. Non-intrusive, like securityheaders.com.
scan.note: Non-intrusive. Only reads responses that are already publicly served — security headers, cookie flags, CORS, and the Server/X-Powered-By banner → CVE. It does not send attack payloads, write data, or brute-force (like securityheaders.com / SSL Labs). For in-depth testing, use the CLI on targets you own or are authorized to test.
scan.no_backend_cfg: Backend is not configured. Deploy the Worker (see worker/README.md) then open the page with ?api=https://...workers.dev.
